name: ChaiCut
tagline: Two perfect cups a day. No more, no less.
prompt: A habit tracker for chai lovers in Bengaluru who want to cut down to two cups a day

spec.name: ChaiCut
spec.world: Bengaluru's iconic chai spots (Sardarji's in Indiranagar, Sharon Tea Stall in Koramangala, Chai Point, and the local tapri outside RMZ Ecospace). The standard daily budget is 2 cups (₹20 to ₹180 per cup). Our main user, Ananya, tracks her daily cups (usually Ginger or Cardamom Kadak) to keep her acidity score at 'Cool' and save ₹140 a day.

spec.summary: A habit companion designed specifically for Bengaluru's chai lovers to enjoy their daily brew mindfully, reducing caffeine and acidity while keeping the ritual alive.
spec.tagline: Two perfect cups a day. No more, no less.
spec.audience: Bengaluru developers, tech workers, and students who drink 5+ cups of tapri or office chai daily and want to limit it to two high-quality sessions.

directions.why: The warm, comforting nature of chai is highly sensory. Gentle clay-like tones and soft physical metaphors match the cozy, mindful habit reduction process.
directions.twist: A clay-pot theme inspired by traditional kulhads, featuring warm terracotta gradients (#E2725B), soft grainy noise, and liquid bubbles that expand as you log your cup.

directions.why: Bengaluru tech professionals love clean interfaces, structured data, and high-contrast productivity tools for scheduling and tracking habits.
directions.twist: A highly precise grid that treats chai consumption like a compiler timeline. Monospace fonts, structured columns of tea-break schedules, and strict boundaries with no decorative curves.

directions.why: Bengaluru has a vibrant, youthful, and cheeky cafe culture. A colorful, high-energy gamified interface keeps tracking fun and collaborative.
directions.twist: Thick black outlines, cartoon chai glass characters with expressive faces that look happy when you are at 1 cup but sweat nervously if you click to add a 3rd cup.

spec.heroObject: The today count and your remaining cup budget, framed as warm, glowing liquid states.

directions.why: Bengaluru tech professionals love clean interfaces, structured data, and high-contrast productivity tools for scheduling and tracking habits.
directions.name: Chai Compiler
directions.pitch: A rigorous, ultra-precise grid tracker that converts Bengaluru's chaotic chai breaks into highly optimized productivity windows.
directions.twist: A highly precise grid that treats chai consumption like a compiler timeline. Monospace fonts, structured columns of tea-break schedules, and strict boundaries with no decorative curves.
directions.motion: No animation besides instant mechanical swaps, or a strict 100ms linear fade for state transitions.
directions.imagery: High-contrast architectural black-and-white shots of tech parks, geometric street-level tapri setups, and cropped concrete textures.
signature: A strict time-since-last-brew ticker built in monospaced layout representing wait states
Ruled multi-column tables showing acidity metrics mapped against productivity output
A singular bright red highlight line running vertically down the active column grid block

directions.name: Kadak Pop
directions.pitch: A high-octane, comic-inspired tracker featuring bold outlines, interactive stickers, and expressive animated tea characters that react to your consumption.
directions.twist: Thick black outlines, cartoon chai glass characters with expressive faces that look happy when you are at 1 cup but sweat nervously if you click to add a 3rd cup.
directions.motion: Snappy, high-velocity 100ms translations that physicalize card elements snapping into position on click.
directions.imagery: Hyper-saturated vector stickers with heavy black outlines, thick pop art illustrations of dripping teacups and stylized steam clouds.
signature: A rotated 'Chai Sticker' badge (rotated at exactly -3 degrees) showing your current streak tier
A cute illustrated chai glass character whose mood visibly drops as you cross your daily limit
Card frames that instantly offset-drop a heavy solid shadow on click/press
